title: Automate reproducible onboard builds, sign artifacts, and publish timebound pinned canaries
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Implement a CI/CD flow that produces reproducible model build artifacts, attaches SLSA-style attestations and SBOMs, signs artifacts with our KMS-backed key, and publishes a timebound pinned canary profile for runtime evaluation. The pipeline should: 1) produce deterministic hashes across build workers (source pinning, pinned base images, fixed toolchain), 2) generate provenance metadata and SBOM, 3) run an automated perf/regression harness and smoke tests, 4) sign artifacts with KMS-wrapped key and upload to the artifact registry, 5) publish a canary pin that is timebound (e.g., 48h automatic expiry) and is gated on perf thresholds, 6) support manual quick-approve and immediate rollback, 7) emit verification endpoints for runtime to validate signatures before deployment. Acceptance criteria: - Builds are reproducible within CI matrix (no timestamp or non-deterministic outputs) and produce identical sha256 across two independent runners; - Every artifact uploaded has an accompanying attestation.json and sbom.json; - Canary pin endpoint (api/internal/onboard/pin) returns metadata and expiry; - Canary gating rules automatically reject pins where latency regresses >7% at p50 or cost per token increases >10% vs baseline; - KMS signatures rotate via key version metadata and older signatures remain verifiable; - CI job artifacts and attestations are discoverable via the model registry UI and linked from the console onboarding flow; - Pipeline integrates with runtime verification library to allow canary deployment without code changes to serving runtime; - Security review completed and documented. Non-goals: full GA rollout automation (we only publish timebound canaries and pinned artifacts; full staging/GA promotion handled by separate release workflow). Implementation notes: - Use a deterministic builder image (bazel/kaniko or buildkit with reproducible flags) and record toolchain hashes. - Implement SLSA v1-like attestation envelope with fields: builder_id, inputs (git ref + submodule pins), commands, output_hash, sbom_ref. - Use KMS (Cloud KMS / AWS KMS) to perform signature operation inside CI, but never export private key material. - Upload artifacts and attestations to the model artifact registry path: gs://redwood-model-artifacts/<model>/builds/<sha>-<timestamp> (attestation and sbom next to artifact). - Canary pin metadata contains: model_hash, profile_id, expiry_iso, gating_metrics, signed_attestation_url. - Integrate the perf harness (benchmarks/repro) that runs a small suite of curated prompts and logs per-token latency, p50/p95, and quality checks. - Add a verification step that can be run locally: ./scripts/verify-artifact --artifact <url> --attestation <url>. Rollout plan: - Phase 1 (testing): run pipeline for internal models only, monitor console dashboard; - Phase 2 (canary): enable timebound pin publish for partner teams, collect telemetry for 48h; - Phase 3 (GA): add promotion path to pinned releases (separate ticket). Metrics to monitor: % reproducible builds, signed artifacts per week, canary acceptance rate, perf regression alerts.
